note: pagerer_example is a trivial demo submodule of Pagerer: one publicly accessible route pagerer_example.page at /pagerer/example (controller PagererExampleController::examplePage) that renders two sample Pagerer-styled pagers over the watchdog and key_value tables. No config, permissions, services or plugins. Because there is nothing to build or configure, the tiers are 3 easy + 1 medium (introspect the live route) + 1 hard (uninstall then re-enable the module, verified against live module state and route registration). Fixtures: none created; the hard case only toggles the module (directory left intact, so no orphaned module).

evals.prompt: After enabling the pagerer_example submodule, at what URL is its demo page, and does a visitor need any special permission to view it?
evals.expected_output: The demo page is at /pagerer/example (route pagerer_example.page). Its access requirement is _access: 'TRUE', so it is publicly accessible - no special permission needed.

evals.prompt: What does the pagerer_example module's page actually demonstrate about Pagerer?
evals.expected_output: It renders two independent Pagerer-styled pagers (pager elements 0 and 1) over paged queries of the core watchdog and key_value tables, showing multiple pagers working on one page; the page title also displays the running Pagerer version.

evals.prompt: In the pagerer_example submodule, which controller and route serve the demo page, and which Pagerer service does the controller depend on?
evals.expected_output: Route pagerer_example.page maps to Drupal\pagerer_example\Controller\PagererExampleController::examplePage; the controller injects the pagerer.style.manager plugin manager (plus database and extension.list.module).

evals.prompt: Inspect the running Drupal site and report the path of the route named pagerer_example.page (the Pagerer example page).
evals.expected_output: The route pagerer_example.page has path /pagerer/example (discoverable via the route provider, e.g. \Drupal::service('router.route_provider')->getRouteByName('pagerer_example.page')->getPath()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Pagerer example submodule (pagerer_example) is currently not installed. Install/enable it so its demo page at /pagerer/example becomes available. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The pagerer_example module is enabled (e.g. drush en pagerer_example -y) and its route pagerer_example.page (/pagerer/example) is registered.
